
```{r,kable}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: true
#| results: "asis"
#| output: true
#| message: false
#| tbl-colwidths: [5%,10%,60%,35%]




library(kableExtra)
df<-data.frame(id=1:26,eins=letters,zwei=letters,drei=letters)
# if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
cat(knitr::kable(df,row.names = F,booktabs = F, format="html",escape=F) %>% 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), 
                    full_width = T) 
                    %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "5%") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "20%") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "55%") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "25%")
  )
# }
```
